title: An inactive unused shop term can be reactivated or deleted
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop made a term of its own, never used it, and then switched it off.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, deactivated and held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-17 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Inactive" tab.
  2. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  3. Hover "Reactivate".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Inactive tab shows the term.
  • Step 2: the menu shows exactly these items, in this order: "Reactivate" (rotate), "Move Customers" (person, greyed out), "Delete Credit Term" (trash, in red, below a divider). Nothing else shows.
  • Step 3: the hover reads "Show in pickers again".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions), story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S2-R1: “Each row's "⋯" menu shows only the items that apply to that term, in this order. An item that applies but is blocked shows greyed out and does nothing when clicked; hovering it shows the reason.”
  • S2-R1 table, Reactivate row: “"Reactivate" (rotate) | Inactive terms; on the Inactive tab it comes before "Move Customers" | Never”
  • S2-R10: “Make Default is not available on inactive terms (it is absent from their menu).”
  • S3-N2: “If the term is in use, standard, or inactive, Edit is not offered or is blocked (Story 2: Row menu actions), so the window cannot open in Edit mode for it.”
